---
title: "Crime Hotspots"
---

```{r setup}
source("03_dashboard.R")
crime <- load_crime_data("data/MPLS_crime.csv")

# Convert UTM km → WGS84 for leaflet
crime_wgs84 <- crime |>
  dplyr::mutate(x_m = x * 1000, y_m = y * 1000) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x_m", "y_m"),
               crs = "+proj=utm +zone=15 +datum=WGS84") |>
  sf::st_transform(crs = 4326) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lng = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    lat = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  ) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

make_heatmap <- function(df_year) {
  dom     <- dplyr::filter(df_year, Offense == "Domestic")
  nondom  <- dplyr::filter(df_year, Offense == "Non-Domestic")
  leaflet::leaflet() |>
    leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.DarkMatter") |>
    leaflet.extras::addHeatmap(
      data = dom, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
      group = "Domestic",
      blur = 25, max = 0.08, radius = 18,
      gradient = c("#4f0012", "#e05c68", "#ffcdd2")
    ) |>
    leaflet.extras::addHeatmap(
      data = nondom, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
      group = "Non-Domestic",
      blur = 25, max = 0.08, radius = 18,
      gradient = c("#001a3a", "#4f8ef7", "#bbdefb")
    ) |>
    leaflet::addLayersControl(
      overlayGroups = c("Domestic", "Non-Domestic"),
      options = leaflet::layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )
}
```

## Assault Density by Year

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 2020

```{r map-2020}
make_heatmap(dplyr::filter(crime_wgs84, year == "2020"))
```

### 2021

```{r map-2021}
make_heatmap(dplyr::filter(crime_wgs84, year == "2021"))
```

### 2022

```{r map-2022}
make_heatmap(dplyr::filter(crime_wgs84, year == "2022"))
```

:::

> Toggle layers with the control panel. Red = domestic assault; blue = non-domestic aggravated assault.
